Smart Shield evolves Argo; monitor Cloudflare changelog. Always check editability before attempting to enable/disable Argo. Set up billing notifications; combine with Tiered Cache; production only (disable dev/staging); monitor analytics (500+ requests/48h); handle billing/permissions/zone errors; test changes in staging; use TypeScript SDK; implement retry logic; document zone settings.

Unavailable: verify Enterprise+, Account → Billing, valid payment; contact support. Unchanged/`editable: false`: check `Zone:Argo Smart Routing:Edit`, billing, plan, holds/suspensions, scopes. GET status; if `!status.editable`, don't modify; otherwise PATCH. Rate limit: 1200 requests/5 min; use `RateLimitError`, `retry-after`, exponential backoff. Proxied traffic only; DDoS/WAF traffic excluded; analytics latency 1–5 min.
